description: Side-by-side photo of two browser windows on monitors, framed in black with a large caption claiming a map of where illegal immigrants live 'perfectly overlaps' blue counties where Democrats vote. The left window shows a Washington Post article with a bubble map of the estimated percentage of undocumented immigrants by area (data from Pew Research, callouts for Yakima WA, Yuma AZ, Gainesville GA). The right window shows the New York Times interactive 2016 election precinct-level voting map, mostly red with blue patches. The caption's overlap claim is the image creator's assertion, not shown by either source map.
